description: Reviewed name crosswalk for the canonical drop records (contract C1; decisions D3-4, D3-6, D3-7, D3-8). One row per member of each drop owner's membership list: the 6 Maple Island monsters (membership = Hidden Street's 'Before Chaos' drop lists, tools/hiddenstreet/captures/monsters.json) and the Wooden Box (membership = MeowDB's live breakable page, tools/meowdb/captures/breakable_0000001.txt). Each row joins the member, BY NAME, to a local MeowDB item (game/data/canonical/items/<id>.json) and to a row of the owner's KuroDB page (tools/kurodb/captures). Read only by tools/sources/drops_merge.mjs, which fails on any member without a row, any row without a member, and any claim the captures or the local items do not support.
reviewed_by: drops package (Iteration Three), from the dated captures and the local MeowDB cache; starting point: the drops auditor's table (docs/review/it3_audit.json, domain 'drops'), every row re-checked
rules: Never join by id across sites. KuroDB, MeowDB and Hidden Street ids are unrelated: KuroDB 4000019 is Snail Shell while MeowDB's game_item_id 4000001 is Snail Shell, and KuroDB 4000001 is Orange Mushroom Cap; KuroDB Apple 2010000 equals the MeowDB game_item_id of Roger's Apple (235). kuro_item_id is only ever used to find a row on the same KuroDB page.

match methods: exact = the same name, character for character (list whitespace trimmed); normalized = equal under tools/sources/parse.mjs normalizeItemName, with a gender suffix '(M)'/'(F)' compared against the MeowDB item's own gender field; alias_with_evidence = different names joined by the evidence written in the row; none = no match.

meowdb.state: resolved = a local MeowDB item (game/data/canonical/items/<id>.json) is the member; not_in_snapshot = MeowDB has (or may have) the item but no local definition exists (candidates lists the MeowDB ids seen in the cache); ambiguous = several MeowDB items fit and nothing offline decides between them. An unresolved member stays in the record with item_id null and never rolls.

kurodb.state: matched = the owner's KuroDB page has a row for this member (its chance is used); none = it has none (the chance stays unresolved and the member never rolls). A KuroDB row that no member matches is written to excluded_kuro_only: KuroDB never adds a member (D3-6). A 'candidate' records a KuroDB row that may be this member but is not accepted (D3-8); it is excluded with the reason given.
Evidence names files of the local MeowDB cache (tools/meowdb/.cache, git-ignored) and the dated captures (tools/*/captures).

rows.name: Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece

meowdb.evidence: MeowDB has two items named 'Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece' (347, icon key 4000000; 2584, icon key 4000067). 347 is the one MeowDB's own Tutorial Jr. Sentinel drop list uses (api_drops_q_monsterId_1.html) and the one quest 1005's itemRefs name (docs/canonical/quests.md, discrepancy 1); 2584 is needed by a Victoria Island quest.

kurodb.evidence: tools/kurodb/captures/9300018.json: 'Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece' 100.00% base | Qty 1 | Quest 1035 (the page's only row).

rows.reviewer_note: KuroDB flags the row 'Quest 1035'; under the C1 gate rule (D3-9) it is recorded as corroboration only: 347 is MeowDB subtype 'Monster Drop', so the entry is not quest-gated.
